import sys, math
import torch
_P = False
def run(q, k_cache, v_cache, kv_indptr, kv_indices, sm_scale=None, **kw):
    global _P
    if not _P:
        _P = True
        sys.stderr.write(
            "[TRACE_APPLY_SOLUTION] gqa_paged_decode invoked "
            f"q={tuple(q.shape)}/{q.dtype} k={tuple(k_cache.shape)}/{k_cache.dtype} "
            f"indptr={tuple(kv_indptr.shape)} indices={tuple(kv_indices.shape)} sm_scale={sm_scale}\n"
        ); sys.stderr.flush()
    nt, hq, d = q.shape
    hkv = k_cache.shape[-2]
    group = hq // hkv
    scale = float(sm_scale) if sm_scale is not None else 1.0 / math.sqrt(d)
    out = torch.empty_like(q)
    for b in range(nt):  # batch_size==num query tokens (bs=1 decode -> nt=1)
        s, e = int(kv_indptr[b].item()), int(kv_indptr[b + 1].item())
        idx = kv_indices[s:e].long()
        k = k_cache.index_select(0, idx).to(torch.float32)  # [S, hkv, d]
        v = v_cache.index_select(0, idx).to(torch.float32)
        qf = q[b].to(torch.float32)                         # [hq, d]
        for h in range(hq):
            kh = k[:, h // group, :]                        # [S, d]
            vh = v[:, h // group, :]
            p = torch.softmax((qf[h] @ kh.t()) * scale, dim=-1)
            out[b, h] = (p @ vh).to(q.dtype)
    return out

description: Reference GQA paged decode (bs=1) to demonstrate stateful plan/run Trace Apply.
